prompt: Edit the exact approved Page 3 crop into three subtle registered phases. Change only tiny local details in the boiling surface granulation, corona filaments, and core glow. Preserve the exact camera, centre, outline, size, corona extent, cutaway geometry, layer boundaries, starfield, overall brightness, palette, and composition. Separately remove the star to make the balance-animation under-plate.
